parameters.parameter: <%= require 'json'; require 'time'; { 'values' => { 'Status' => 'Sent', 'Sent At' => Time.now.utc.iso8601, 'Delivery Results' => { 'channel' => @values['Channel'], 'simulated' => true, 'reason' => 'notify-gw integration not configured in pilot', 'recipients' => @values['Audience Size'].to_i, 'delivered' => @values['Audience Size'].to_i, 'failed' => 0 }.to_json } }.to_json %>

<%= require 'json'; require 'time'; { 'values' => { 'Comms State' => 'Sent', 'Next Update Due At' => (Time.now.utc + (@values['Sequence'] == 'Resolution' ? 0 : 3600)).iso8601 } }.to_json %>
